# dsh-neocortex
Zhinao (Neocortex) — a Markdown-authoritative second brain for DeepSeek Harness, with a local recall
ledger, lifecycle engine, weekly review and a Web panel.
## Features
- **Layered memory (L1/L2/L3)**: L1 long-term model (background, collaboration preferences, task sta
ndards) gated by user confirmation; L2 knowledge written automatically with mandatory sources; L3 re

cent status written directly under daily quotas.
- **Local ledger with recall explanations**: a cras
h-conscious local ledger accounts for every recall and write; the Web panel explains why a memory wa

s injected.
- **Lifecycle & weekly review**: scenes and entries sleep, wake, revive and get promoted
by bounded rules; a resumable weekly review queues L1 candidates and sleeping entries for the user.
- **Web panel**: state, recall explanations, L1-only confirmation, review actions, read-only L2 aud

it, undo, and six bounded settings sliders.
- **Blank template initialization / takeover**: first ru
n initializes your brain from a generic, personal-info-free Markdown skeleton, or adopts an existing
Zhinao directory without touching its files.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness (DSH) `>= 0.2.1-rc.5`.
- Verified on Windows.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
or install `dsh-neocortex` from a DSH plugin market in the GUI.
## First run
Open **Settings → Plugins → Zhinao / Neocortex** and run the setup wizard. You choose the directory
yourself in every mode:
- **New brain**: pick an empty directory; the wizard copies the blank template into it. Any conflict

ing file aborts the initialization — nothing is overwritten.
- **Use existing**: point to an existin

g Zhinao directory; the wizard only verifies it and never modifies existing files.
- **Upgrade skele
ton**: point to an existing but incomplete Zhinao directory; the wizard creates only the missing ske
leton files and skips every file that already exists.
## Usage
Agents get three tools:

- `neocortex_remember` — write one atomic fact to L1/L2/L3 with quota or queue feedback.
- `neocorte
x_recall` — recall general and sleeping personal history; routes external-knowledge questions to web

search.
- `neocortex_panel` — panel state, review preview, undo, review execution/retry, and bounde
d settings updates. L1 confirmation and weekly-review accept/reject stay user-only.
You can also steer it in natural language: "skip the brain this time" (no read/write), "don't rememb
er this" (don't save), "remember this" (save it).
## Uninstall
Removing the plugin does **not** delete your brain data: the Markdown files, the local ledger and se
ttings stay on disk.
